summary: ChatProgress gains form="typing": PEOPLE's presence, the sheet's Gaps row made real. One line — the Typing matrix at 16px in muted ink (a person, never the agent's accent), gap-sm, then a caption line in which `who` truncates and the verb never does, so the longest name gives way first. It is not progress and never competes for the turn's live edge: it is placed on the composer's top edge, never in the thread. The type refuses every run prop on it — clock, receipt, Stop, Retry, failure, disclosure, icon — and requires `who`. Placing it on the composer is the caller's for now; ChatComposer has no slot for it.
